newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate slides to 11 vs 11.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate slides to 11 vs 11.54 pct.

text.p: Stronger volume of short-term lending on Monday weighed the Croatian average money market rate down 54 basis points to 11 percent despite weak liquidity.
The day's settlements totalled 68.6 million kuna, leaving a shortfall of 2.4 million in demand.
All but 19 million kuna were fresh borrowings, mostly call money at a stable 10.5 percent rate.
Insurers rolled over one-week money at 9.0 percent.
Banks charged 11 percent for renewed one-week loans, 13 percent for two-week and 15-17 percent for one-month money.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrate for Tuesday firmer at 6.0606 to the dollar and 3.5680 against the mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-455 7075
